nft_auction.description: Active auction for a token, if any.

private_nft_auction.description: Open private auction for a token, if any.

private_policy.description: Share allocation and thresholds used by private bids.

private_signing_digest.description: The 32-byte digest a FROST group signs for `action`.

bind_finalize.description: Proof-of-possession of `finalize_vk` at bid time (6-of-6 => B, P and S present).

bind_reclaim.description: Proof-of-possession of `reclaim_vk` at bid time (5-of-6 => B and P present).

finalize.description: Settle the auction to this bid and record the shielded payment (`finalize_vk`).

reclaim.description: Close the bid and record the shielded refund (signed by `reclaim_vk`).

definitions.name: cosmwasm_std_hex_binary_HexBinary
definitions.description:
This is a wrapper around Vec<u8> to add hex de/serialization
with serde. It also adds some helper methods to help encode inline.

This is similar to `cosmwasm_std::Binary` but uses hex.
See also <https://github.com/CosmWasm/cosmwasm/blob/main/docs/MESSAGE_TYPES.md>.

definitions.name: svg_auction_private_ShieldedRelease
definitions.description: A Zcash payment authorised by a bid group, as recorded on Terp.

notes_cm.description:
`blake2b(NOTES_DOMAIN || n || note_1 || .. || note_n)` over the 382-byte
SEAM-NOTE-OUT encodings of the payment outputs (see [`notes_preimage`]). Each note
carries a random `rcm`, so the commitment hides values and destinations.

ovk_ciphertext.description: The same notes encrypted under the bid's OVK. Opaque on chain.

payment_cm.description:
Finalize only: note commitment of the seller's payment output, which the payment
client must attest as included on Zcash.

definitions.name: cosmwasm_std_binary_Binary
definitions.description:
Binary is a wrapper around Vec<u8> to add base64 de/serialization
with serde. It also adds some helper methods to help encode inline.

This is only needed as serde-json-{core,wasm} has a horrible encoding for Vec<u8>.
See also <https://github.com/CosmWasm/cosmwasm/blob/main/docs/MESSAGE_TYPES.md>.
